error_reason: The WebSurfer agent repeated the exact same search query from Turn 10 through Turn 14. The Planner explicitly identified this repetition in Turn 11 and reiterated the need for additional corroboration, yet the WebSurfer continued to execute the identical failing search without variation or adaptation, demonstrating rigid turn configuration and failure to learn from previous failures.

suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent modified the site: parameter and the year in each step (imdb -> billboard -> mtv -> rollingstone), changing the year from 1999 to 2000 in Turn 13. This demonstrates active search space exploration, not rigid repetition of the exact same query.

probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis incorrectly labels the behavior as 'step_repetition' and 'identical failing search'. The trace context clearly shows the WebSurfer agent varied its queries across Turns 10-14 by changing the specific website (imdb.com, billboard.com, mtv.com, rollingstone.com) and adjusting the year (1999 vs 2000) in Turn 13. The Planner even acknowledged the variation in Turn 11. While the search strategy might be inefficient (e.g., sticking to a single query string structure across sites without refining the query logic itself), it is not a 'rigid turn configuration' where the agent repeats the *exact same* search. The error type is therefore misidentified.
